question: Which model should answer `request.newest_message`? Judge only the newest message; `request.prior_turns` is context for what it refers to, never the thing being routed.

models.name: qwen-small
models.criterion: The newest user message asks for a mechanical transformation that a competent engineer would finish without stopping to think: renaming or reformatting code, converting between two named formats, extracting values that are already written down in the message, translating prose, or answering a single factual question whose answer the message already contains. Length alone does not qualify a request for this option; a long but mechanical request still belongs here. This option does not apply, no matter how mechanical the task looks, if the code, field, file or output touches money or billing in any way (amounts, prices, charges, payouts, invoices, refunds, currency, cache of a price/rate, etc.) — such requests always go to the other option.

models.name: qwen-large
models.criterion: The newest user message cannot be answered until something is worked out first: weighing a trade-off between two approaches, designing something that does not exist yet, diagnosing a fault from evidence that does not name the cause, reasoning about consequences the message does not state, or producing code whose correctness depends on a rule that has to be derived. Shortness does not disqualify a request from this option; a one-line question can still need deliberation. This option also always applies, even when the task is purely mechanical and would otherwise belong to the other option, whenever the request involves money or billing in any way: amounts, prices, charges, payouts, invoices, refunds, currency conversion, or code/fields/files in a billing or payments context.
